waves.title: Final Backend Active Slice Verification And Gate
waves.goal: Own the canonical runtime closeout for the completed backend active-slice canon and dev-observability work.
canonical_flow_commands: docker exec astro-project-backend-1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_day_brief.py tests/test_day_brief_schema.py tests/test_week_brief_service.py tests/test_week_brief_api.py tests/test_logging_utils_grace.py tests/test_catalog_logging.py tests/test_billing_scheduler.py

acceptance_criteria: Final verifier records backend quick, targeted pytest, and canonical today-week observability outcomes.
The observability verdict is explicit and limited to clean, degraded-but-expected, unexpected-degradation, or no-evidence-blocker.
Reviewer confirms frozen-scope containment and behavior preservation before architect acceptance.

requirements.xml: Added a backend active-slice dev-observability invariant requiring dense structured markers on entry, major step, branch, fallback, retry, persistence, exception-conversion, and closeout while preserving business semantics.
Added explicit failure-handling language that packet-local read-only evidence cannot close the slice and that final today-week no-evidence-blocker or unexpected-degradation blocks acceptance.
Added DEFECT-BACKEND-ACTIVE-DEV-OBS-GAPS and a success criterion for trace reconstruction by module/function/block plus correlation identifiers.
technology.xml: Clarified that this feature reuses the current GRACE logging envelope and correlation model only across main.py, logging_utils.py, middleware/correlation.py, day_brief.py, day_brief_validators.py, week_brief_service.py, scheduler.py, and analytics.py.
Added the read-only post-test review command and codified read-only review as packet-local versus today-week review as wave-final.
Added verification guidance that the latest emitted trace, request, and report identifiers must make the scenario reconstructable without widening into a logging transport rewrite.
development-plan.xml: Added FLOW-BACKEND-ACTIVE-DEV-OBS and sequenced dense observability after stable contract naming on the same bounded module cluster.
Added a distinct backend active-slice dev-observability execution packet after canon gap closure and before the final gate.
Clarified that day_brief_validators.py remains a pure helper and that caller boundaries, not every pure helper, own dense observability.
knowledge-graph.xml: Added a feature-local slice artifact node set for backend-grace-canon-full-dev-observability and linked it to the existing backend active-slice module cluster.
Recorded upstream and downstream edges for API gateway, trace logging, DayBrief, WeekBrief, scheduler, analytics, structured logs, and analytics_events under the new dev-observability flow.
Added the dev-observability verifier lanes to the existing backend active-slice flow.
verification-matrix.md: Added packet-local VM rows for W01 canon gap closure and W02 dev-observability densification using read-only post-test review.
Added a wave-final VM requiring backend quick, targeted pytest, and today-week review with explicit clean, degraded-but-expected, unexpected-degradation, or no-evidence-blocker verdict.
Documented that scheduler or analytics non-emission may only be accepted when explicitly classified, not silently ignored.
